messages.content: You write a complete standard-library-only Rust program for the given ConcIR model. Emit `cir_trace::ev("<tag>", "<sid>")` exactly as codegen does: after `mutex_lock`/`semaphore_acquire`/`condvar_wait`/`channel_send`/`channel_recv` return, and at `mutex_unlock`/`condvar_notify`/`condvar_notify_all`/`semaphore_release`/`spawn`/`scope`/`join`; use tag `t0` for main and `t<sid>_<i>` for the i-th member of a `scope`, with the sid from the CIR. You MUST call `cir_trace::finish()` once at the end of `main` (the runtime is already provided as `mod cir_trace`). Define `fn main`, use no external crate, and output only the Rust source in one ```rust fence.
